name: Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents
source:
Step into a dark and unforgiving world where vampires pull the strings of humanity. You are not the hero, you are not the villain, you are nothing but a pawn in schemes that you cannot even begin to understand.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
走进一个黑暗无情的世界，吸血鬼操纵着人类。你不是英雄，你不是恶棍，你只是一个你甚至无法理解的计划中的棋子。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715020/]Steam[/url]]
